newsitem.title: GREECE: NATIONAL BANK CONSIDERING GROUP TREASURY.
newsitem.headline: NATIONAL BANK CONSIDERING GROUP TREASURY.

text.p: State National Bank of Greece is considering setting up a group treasury operation to capitalise on its long presence in large financial markets in London, Frankfurt, Paris and New York, it said on Monday.

National Bank's governor Theodore Karatzas headed the first meeting of the bank's coordinating council on foreign operations where it was estimated that pretax earnings from the group's foreign operations will reach about 10 billion drachmas this year.

Participating in the coordinating council were deputy governors Karamouzis, Stamoulis, Pantalakis and Vranas as well as heads of the bank's branches abroad. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
